claims.sourceText: Membership, Publications, and Other Pertinent Information of the Joint Committee on Atomic Energy, Joint Committee Print, February 1962, GPO 80013, section II, https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/CPRT-87JPRT80013/pdf/CPRT-87JPRT80013.pdf
claims.text: Where McMahon actually is in the record: the 1962 Joint Committee print lists under 'MEMBERSHIP OF THE JOINT COMMITTEE, 1945-61' the 'SENATE SPECIAL COMMITTEE ON ATOMIC ENERGY, Seventy-ninth Congress (1945-46), BRIEN McMAHON, Connecticut, Chairman', and then the 'JOINT COMMITTEE ON ATOMIC ENERGY, Seventy-ninth Congress (1946), BRIEN McMAHON, Connecticut, Chairman'. None of the federal documents opened for this node calls the Act the McMahon Act.

title: Membership, Publications, and Other Pertinent Information of the Joint Committee on Atomic Energy, Joint Committee Print, February 1962 (GPO 80013)
